---
title: "NFL Props Model — Weekly Card"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  season: 2026
  week: 1
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({ library(dplyr); library(readr); library(knitr) })
snap_path <- file.path("data", "results",
                       sprintf("projections_%d_w%02d.csv",
                               params$season, params$week))
snap <- if (file.exists(snap_path))
  read_csv(snap_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
has_lines <- !is.null(snap) && any(!is.na(snap$line))
```

# Season `r params$season` — Week `r params$week`

```{r no-data, results="asis"}
if (is.null(snap)) cat("**No snapshot found for this week — run run_model.R first.**")
```

```{r edges, results="asis"}
if (has_lines) {
  cat("## Top edges\n\n(model P(over) vs no-vig market P(over), min 3% edge)\n")
} else if (!is.null(snap)) {
  cat("## Projections\n\n*No prop lines available (offseason or fetch failure)",
      "— showing raw projections.*\n")
}
```

```{r edge-table}
if (has_lines) {
  snap %>%
    filter(!is.na(edge), lean != "PASS") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(edge))) %>%
    head(25) %>%
    transmute(Player = player_name, Pos = position, Team = team,
              Opp = opponent, Market = market, Line = line,
              Proj = round(proj, 2), `Model P(over)` = round(model_p_over, 3),
              `Mkt P(over)` = round(market_p_over, 3),
              Edge = sprintf("%+.1f%%", 100 * edge), Lean = lean,
              Book = sportsbook) %>%
    kable()
}
```

## Receptions

```{r rec}
if (!is.null(snap)) {
  snap %>% filter(market == "receptions") %>%
    arrange(desc(proj)) %>% head(30) %>%
    transmute(Player = player_name, Pos = position, Team = team,
              Opp = opponent, `Proj rec` = round(proj, 2),
              Line = line, `P(over)` = round(p_over_line, 3)) %>%
    kable()
}
```

## QB passing yards

```{r qby}
if (!is.null(snap)) {
  snap %>% filter(market == "pass_yards") %>%
    arrange(desc(proj)) %>%
    transmute(Player = player_name, Team = team, Opp = opponent,
              `Proj yds` = round(proj, 1), Line = line,
              `P(over)` = round(p_over_line, 3)) %>%
    kable()
}
```

## QB passing TDs

```{r qtd}
if (!is.null(snap)) {
  snap %>% filter(market == "pass_tds") %>%
    arrange(desc(proj)) %>%
    transmute(Player = player_name, Team = team, Opp = opponent,
              `Proj TD` = round(proj, 2), Line = line,
              `P(over)` = round(p_over_line, 3)) %>%
    kable()
}
```

## Anytime TD

```{r any}
if (!is.null(snap)) {
  snap %>% filter(market == "anytime_td") %>%
    arrange(desc(proj)) %>% head(40) %>%
    transmute(Player = player_name, Pos = position, Team = team,
              Opp = opponent, `P(anytime)` = round(proj, 3),
              `Fair odds` = implied_to_amer(proj)) %>%
    kable()
}
```
